what: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
text: highdir R package provides unified, backend-agnostic API building figures either highcharter (interactive) ggplot2 (static). figure described fig_spec object rendered either backend without changing calling code. package ships default use Helsedirektoratet colour palette, styling theme. Shiny GUI introduce make user friendly.

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: # Install from GitHub (dev branch) remotes::install_github("folkehelsestats/highdir@dev")

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: library(highdir)  df <- data.frame(   age  = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 2),   sex  = rep(c("Male", "Female"), 4),   pct  = c(42, 38, 55, 61, 48, 52, 60, 57),   n    = c(120, 115, 200, 210, 180, 175, 160, 155) )  # 1. Describe the figure once spec <- fig_spec(   data     = df,   x        = "age",   y        = "pct",   group    = "sex",   n        = "n",            # shown in highcharter tooltips   title    = "Health survey results",   subtitle = "Source: Example data",   caption  = "Tall om helse" )  # 2. Render to highcharter (interactive, default) make_fig(spec, "column")  # 3. Same spec → ggplot2 (static) make_fig(spec, "column", backend = "ggplot2")  # 4. Line chart with smooth spline and hover band make_fig(spec, "line", smooth = TRUE)  # 5. Disable JavaScript (for static HTML export) make_fig(spec, "column", use_js = FALSE)  # 6. Save hd_save(make_fig(spec, "column"), "chart.html") hd_save(make_fig(spec, "column", backend = "ggplot2"), "chart.png")

title: Backend-Agnostic Figure Builder for Highcharter and ggplot2
code: # Set package-wide defaults for the session hd_set_theme(   hc_theme = "economist",   colors   = c("#025169", "#7C145C", "#C68803"),   font     = "Source Sans Pro" )  # All subsequent make_fig() calls use these settings automatically make_fig(spec, "column")

title: Create a Figure Specification — fig_spec
text: data data.frame (data.table) containing referenced columns. x Character. Column name x-axis variable. y Character. Column name y-axis variable (typically percentage count). group Character NULL. Column name used split data multiple series / groups. n Character NULL. Column name raw count variable shown highcharter tooltips alongside y value. Ignored ggplot2. colour Character NULL. Column name mapped colour aesthetic (ggplot2 ; highcharter uses group colouring). xlab Character NULL. X-axis label. Defaults x NULL. ylab Character NULL. Y-axis label. Defaults y NULL. title Character NULL. Chart title. subtitle Character NULL. Chart subtitle. Defaults "Kilde: Navn av kilder" highcharter engine NULL. caption Character NULL. Caption text shown chart (highcharter ). ylim Numeric vector length 2 NULL. Fixed y-axis limits, e.g. c(0, 100). NULL lets backend determine limits automatically. yint Numeric. Y-axis tick interval. Default 10. flip Logical. Invert axes (horizontal bars). Default FALSE.

title: Save a Figure to Disk — hd_save
text: fig highchart ggplot object. file Character. Output file path including extension, e.g. "output/chart.html" "output/chart.png". type Character. Explicit format override. One "auto" (infer extension), "html", "json", "png", "svg", "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff". Default: "auto". width Numeric. Output width. Inches ggplot2; pixels highcharter PNG. Default: 8. height Numeric. Output height. Inches ggplot2; pixels highcharter PNG. Default: 5. dpi Numeric. Resolution raster ggplot2 exports. Default: 300. selfcontained Logical. HTML export, embed JS/CSS file self-contained portable. Default: TRUE. delay Numeric. Seconds wait JavaScript finish rendering taking PNG screenshot highcharter widget. Default: 0.8. ... Additional arguments forwarded ggplot2::ggsave() (ggplot2 figures ).

what: Build a Figure from a Specification — make_fig
title: Build a Figure from a Specification — make_fig
text: Renders fig_spec object using selected backend. primary function users call constructing specification fig_spec().

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — make_fig
code: make_fig(   spec,   type = "column",   backend = "highcharter",   use_js = TRUE,   filename = NULL,   smooth = TRUE,   dot_size = 4,   line_symbols = NULL,   colors = NULL,   ... )

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — make_fig
text: spec fig_spec object created fig_spec(). type Character. Geometry use. One values returned list_geoms(): "column", "line", "scatter", "arearange", custom geometry registered register_geom(). backend Character. Rendering backend. One "highcharter" (default, interactive) "ggplot2" (static), backend registered register_backend(). use_js Logical. Whether include manually-injected JavaScript enhancements highcharter output. Tooltips, hover states, accessibility module, declarative Highcharts features always included regardless setting. TRUE (default), htmlwidgets::JS() hover band added behind active category column/point via point.events.mouseOver / mouseOut. Set FALSE omit custom callback, e.g. want clean widget hand-written JS. effect ggplot2 backend. filename Character NULL. Base filename used Highcharts built-export menu (extension). Defaults "highdir-figure". Ignored ggplot2 backend. smooth Logical. type = "line" . Use spline interpolation smooth curves (TRUE, default) straight line segments (FALSE). dot_size Numeric. type = "line" . Radius line markers pixels. Default 4. line_symbols Character vector NULL. type = "line" . Marker symbol group. Valid values: "circle", "square", "diamond", "triangle", "triangle-". NULL symbols assigned automatically. colors Character vector NULL. Colour overrides figure . NULL palette hd_set_theme() (hdir default palette) used. ... Additional arguments forwarded geometry's render function. Required arguments geometry (e.g. ymin / ymax "arearange") must supplied .

title: Build a Figure from a Specification — make_fig
code: df <- data.frame(   age  = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 2),   sex  = rep(c("Male", "Female"), 4),   pct  = c(42, 38, 55, 61, 48, 52, 60, 57),   n    = c(120, 115, 200, 210, 180, 175, 160, 155) )  spec <- fig_spec(   data     = df,   x        = "age",   y        = "pct",   group    = "sex",   n        = "n",   title    = "Health survey results",   subtitle = "Source: Example data",   caption  = "Tall om helse" ) #> Error in fig_spec(data = df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex", n = "n",     title = "Health survey results", subtitle = "Source: Example data",     caption = "Tall om helse"): could not find function "fig_spec"  if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Interactive highcharter column chart (default) make_fig(spec, "column")  # Same data as a smooth line chart — with JS hover effects make_fig(spec, "line", smooth = TRUE)  # Disable JS (e.g. for self-contained HTML export) make_fig(spec, "column", use_js = FALSE)  # Static ggplot2 version make_fig(spec, "column", backend = "ggplot2")  # Arearange needs extra required args spec2 <- fig_spec(df, x = "age", y = "pct", group = "sex") make_fig(spec2, "arearange", ymin = "pct_lo", ymax = "pct_hi") } # }

title: Create Interactive Highchart Graph with Categories and Groups — make_hist
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(highcharter) library(dplyr)  # Sample data survey_data <- data.frame(   age_group = rep(c("18-24", "25-34", "35-44", "45-54"), each = 3),   gender = rep(c("Male", "Female", "Other"), 4),   percentage = runif(12, 10, 80),   count = sample(50:200, 12) )  # Basic column chart make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Survey Results by Age and Gender")  # Chart with fixed y-axis scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Fixed Y-axis Scale",           ylim = c(0, 70))  # Smooth line chart with custom symbols and fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Smooth Trend Analysis",           type = "line",           smooth = TRUE,           ylim = c(0, 100),           line_symbols = c("circle", "square", "diamond"))  # Regular (angular) line chart make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Angular Line Chart",           type = "line",           smooth = FALSE)  # Horizontal bar chart with fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Horizontal View",           flip = TRUE,           ylim = c(0, 50))  # Custom y-axis intervals with fixed scale make_hist(survey_data, age_group, percentage, gender, count,           title = "Fine-grained Y-axis",           yint = 5,           ylim = c(0, 60)) } # }
